notes:
- Depth of Field, Fog and Depth Lighting stay on in the 1:1 view.
- Sharpening and Skin Softening are groups of nodes you can open and edit, keep the picture's color, and match Affinity's High Pass strength.
- Texture and Clarity are stronger at 100 and keep their scale from preview to export.
- Detail tools and Sharpening stop at edges, with fewer dark rings and halos.
- Depth Lighting no longer lights the background beside a subject.
- A full-resolution settled preview, as a preference, with a choice of frame quality.
- The settled preview follows the window size.
- File and Catalog layers are sharp at 1:1 and sized right at Fit.
- The 1:1 view answers while the graph cards update.
- Inside an open group, delete, undo and reconnect work as they do on the main graph.
- The GPU preview no longer shows a stale frame after an edit.
- Selection Polish's brush refines the edge again, and closing the panel keeps the selection.
- Feather can follow the picture's own edges.
- Marching ants on a speckled selection no longer hold up the screen.
- Filter photographs by the date they were taken.
- The Metadata tab shows more of the file's metadata.
- Pixel sizes follow the photograph's true dimensions, with a one-time catalog upgrade.
- Depth maps and Model noise reduction are computed once more after this update.
- The Custom Chart dialog is two columns, and the Color Checker section starts collapsed.
